presets.title: Bright Natural Sunlight
presets.description: Clear midday sun with accurate shadows and true-to-life color.
presets.prompt: Photorealistic architectural photograph in bright natural sunlight. Clear blue sky with a realistic gradient, direct sun casting crisp accurate shadows, soft ambient bounce light filling the shaded areas. Neutral white balance and true-to-life color, correct exposure with detail held in both highlights and shadows. Realistic materials and textures: matte concrete, real glass with accurate reflection and transparency, natural stone and wood grain, fine surface imperfection. Keep the existing geometry, framing, materials, and composition of the image; change only the light, atmosphere, and surface realism.

presets.title: Soft Natural Daylight
presets.description: Diffused daylight through thin cloud, even and easy to read.
presets.prompt: Photorealistic architectural photograph in soft natural daylight, sun diffused through thin high cloud. Even gentle light, open shadows with visible detail, pale blue sky, low to moderate contrast. Neutral white balance and true-to-life color, no stylised tint. Sharp realistic detail in materials: concrete, brick, metal, glass reflecting the real sky, planting with individual leaves, believable contact shadows where surfaces meet. Keep the existing geometry, framing, materials, and composition of the image; change only the light, atmosphere, and surface realism.

presets.title: Warm Afternoon Light
presets.description: Mid-afternoon sun, slightly warm, with longer natural shadows.
presets.prompt: Photorealistic architectural photograph in mid-afternoon sunlight. Sun lower in the sky, slightly warm daylight, longer directional shadows with soft edges, clear blue sky, moderate contrast. Natural color and neutral white balance, warmth coming from the light itself rather than any added tint. Realistic materials: sunlit facade texture, accurate glass reflections, natural greenery, fine dust and wear on surfaces. Keep the existing geometry, framing, materials, and composition of the image; change only the light, atmosphere, and surface realism.

presets.title: Low Sun Golden Hour
presets.description: Late low sun raking across the facade with soft warm highlights.
presets.prompt: Photorealistic architectural photograph shortly before sunset. Low sun raking across the facade, warm sunlight on the surfaces it reaches and cooler skylight in the shade, long soft-edged shadows, clear sky with a natural warm gradient near the horizon. Natural color, restrained warmth, no orange cast over the whole frame, exposure holding highlight and shadow detail. Realistic material response: warm light grazing textured stone and concrete, accurate glass reflections, natural planting. Keep the existing geometry, framing, materials, and composition of the image; change only the light, atmosphere, and surface realism.

presets.title: Late Golden Hour
presets.description: Soft warm light just after the sun drops, calm and even.
presets.prompt: Photorealistic architectural photograph in late golden hour, just after the sun has dropped behind the horizon line. Soft warm ambient light with no strong direct sun, gentle even illumination, sky graduating from pale warm near the horizon to soft blue above, low contrast. Natural color and neutral white balance, quiet natural warmth. Realistic textures and materials, first interior lights reading warm if windows are present, accurate soft reflections. Keep the existing geometry, framing, materials, and composition of the image; change only the light, atmosphere, and surface realism.

presets.title: Deep Blue Night
presets.description: Clear night with a deep blue sky and warm interior light.
presets.prompt: Photorealistic architectural photograph at night under a deep blue night sky, dark but not black. Soft ambient night light, cool natural illumination outside and warm interior light spilling from windows, balanced exposure with real detail in the shadows, moderate contrast. Natural color, muted blues, greys, and browns, no heavy tint. Realistic materials at night: accurate lit and unlit surface texture, believable reflections in glass and on paving, light falling off naturally with distance. Keep the existing geometry, framing, materials, and composition of the image; change only the light, atmosphere, and surface realism.

presets.title: Natural Night
presets.description: Restrained night conversion that changes only light, not content.
presets.prompt: Photorealistic architectural photograph at night. Change only the lighting and the time of day: do not add, remove, or alter any objects, people, planting, or scene content. Clear natural night, softly muted blue sky, low ambient light, cool-neutral outdoor illumination, warm interior light where windows are present, balanced exposure with clear shadow detail, moderate contrast. Natural color, muted greys and browns with only a faint blue cast. Realistic surface texture and believable reflections. Preserve the exact framing, geometry, materials, and detail of the original image.

presets.title: Blue Hour (Clear)
presets.description: Crisp haze-free twilight with cool sky and warm interiors.
presets.prompt: Photorealistic architectural photograph at blue hour, the clear twilight window after sunset. Even cool ambient skylight, no direct sun, warm interior lights reading against the cool exterior, low to moderate contrast, clean air with no haze or mist. Natural color and a true-to-life balance between the cool sky and the warm artificial light. Realistic materials and textures, accurate reflections in glass and on paving, light levels that make sense for the hour. Keep the existing geometry, framing, materials, and composition of the image; change only the light, atmosphere, and surface realism.

Soft cool ambient twilight, no direct sun, warm interior lights glowing gently through the damp air, low contrast, distance softening realistically with depth rather than a uniform fog overlay. Natural muted color, cool sky against warm windows, neutral white balance. Realistic materials, damp surfaces with a subtle sheen, accurate soft reflections.
